english.note: This is the all-purpose numeral for saying that there is a single item, normally followed by the appropriate classifier and noun.

examples.english: I bought one bottle of water.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 zi1 seoi2

english.note: Use 一 before score and quantity units such as hundred, thousand, dozen, or million.

examples.jyutping: jat1 baak3 man1 gau3 m4 gau3 aa3
